_readme: The only model address mapping in this project. model_registry.py reads from here; scripts always get paths through resolve(), no hardcoding allowed. To add a new model, add a models entry (alias all lowercase): write an absolute path for a local directory, write the hub ID for one that goes through the HF cache.

qwen3.5-4b.note: HF cache; main model for fig1/traj pilot

qwen3.5-9b.note: old directory; not yet on the shared disk

qwen3.5-27b.note: shared disk, verified complete on 2026-07-28 (11/11 shards)

qwen3.6-27b.note: shared disk, verified complete on 2026-07-28 (16 shards + tokenizer); multimodal shell Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, 64 layers, bf16 52G, does not fit on a single 48G card

gpt-oss-120b.note: own replica, download finished and accepted on 2026-07-28 (15 shards + tokenizer, ~61G main weights); MoE with ~5B active params, fits on a single H200; the original/ subdirectory (65G) is a reference format, vLLM does not use it

modernbert-base.note: own replica, accepted on 2026-07-29 (config + model.safetensors 571M + tokenizer); ModernBertForMaskedLM, 149M params, max_pos 8192; the onnx/ subdirectory (1.5G) is an export format, transformers does not use it

lfm2.5-350m-base.note: own replica, 681M; in use by the cgen cell, added to the registry on 2026-08-20 (MAP.md previously listed it as a missing entry)

qwen3-0.6b-base.note: own replica, 1.2G; in use by the cgen cell, added to the registry on 2026-08-20 (MAP.md previously listed it as a missing entry)

mirrorapi-cache.note: StableToolBench simulator (Qwen2.5-7B fine-tune, bf16 ~15G); served-model-name must = mirrorapi-cache, added to the registry on 2026-08-20
